description: A stream rule stops an answer that breaks it: the partial answer is taken back (stream-json gets stream_restart), the rule joins the conversation, and the model answers again; the final result is the corrected answer only.
prompt: How do I get a &'static str from a String?

setup_home_files.config.toml:
provider = "vllm"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1"
model = "e2e-model"
[[stream_rules]]
name = "box-leak"
pattern = 'Box::leak'
rule = "Do not use Box::leak; use Arc<str> or an owned String."

contains: use Arc<str> or an owned String.
